## JARVIS CEO v1 - multi-AI (free first, paid last)
Tries Gemini -> Groq -> OpenRouter -> OpenAI. Moves to the next only if one fails or is over its free limit / your budget.
Setup: in each **Call** node pick a credential. Gemini/Groq/OpenRouter: *Header Auth*, Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your key>`. OpenAI: your OpenAI credential.
A provider without a key: set `enabled: false` for it in the Router code. OpenRouter starts disabled until you choose a free model.
Tasks with `contains_personal_data: true` never go to free tiers.
